title: Weird Ai/Alien guy at the empty Hanger in Mall World
content: https://preview.redd.it/mzm7ki969hvf1.png?width=1024&format=png&auto=webp&s=79864084e8cf25d602cb599bba027fa2f3edf29c https://preview.redd.it/67aom11o9hvf1.png?width=1024&format=png&auto=webp&s=436ce627e5f3a75d2e5d31dd8fb43ef1c03d24fb Have you seen this guy with that artefact? He is located in an underground hanger at MallWorld. It seemed as if he was robotic or alien, did not feel human. He asked me to choose between 2 options: Go into the cube. Touch the cube. I felt a horrible presence and it felt as if I touched it or went in I would be forever trapped. I was a smartass and said "Neither, what are you gonna do about it?" So he started glitching. After that I woke up.
